basics.description: Deploy the DentiSystems Threat Intelligence & Active Deception solution for Microsoft Sentinel. Ingest high-fidelity honeypot breach telemetry, GATE zero-trust gateway blocks, and real-time adversary indicators directly into your Log Analytics workspace.

workspace.name: workspace
workspace.label: Log Analytics Workspace

subLabel.preValidation: Select the Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled.

workspace.toolTip: Choose the Microsoft Sentinel onboarded workspace for this solution.

steps.name: dentiSystemsConfig
steps.label: DentiSystems Setup

subLabel.preValidation: Configure your DentiSystems API endpoint and authentication token.

steps.blurb: Provide your DentiSystems tenant credentials to enable automated threat intelligence ingestion into Microsoft Sentinel.

elements.name: apiEndpoint
elements.label: DentiSystems API Endpoint URL
elements.toolTip: Enter your DentiGrid Threat Intelligence API URL.

elements.name: apiKey
elements.label: DentiSystems API Bearer Token
elements.toolTip: Enter your secure DentiSystems API Bearer Token.

elements.name: enableDataConnector
elements.label: Enable Codeless REST API Data Connector
elements.toolTip: Enables automatic scheduled polling of DentiGrid threat feeds directly into your Sentinel workspace.

steps.name: securityContent
steps.label: Security Content & Analytics

subLabel.preValidation: Select detection rules, workbooks, and hunting queries to deploy.

steps.blurb: Choose the pre-built Microsoft Sentinel security content artifacts you wish to deploy:

options.text: Select the security artifacts you wish to deploy alongside the DentiSystems integration:

elements.name: enableAnalyticRules
elements.label: Deploy Pre-configured Sentinel Analytic Detection Rules (4 Rules)
elements.toolTip: Deploys MITRE ATT&CK-mapped Scheduled Alert Rules: High Severity Honeypot Breach, Volumetric Recon/Scan, GATE Zero-Trust Threat Intercept, and SCADA/BMS Protocol Tampering.

elements.name: enableWorkbooks
elements.label: Deploy DentiSystems Threat Intelligence & Deception Dashboard Workbook
elements.toolTip: Deploys an interactive multi-tab Azure Monitor/Sentinel Workbook with attack geolocations, protocol breakdowns, honeypot sensor status, and attacker IP analytics.

elements.name: enableHuntingQueries
elements.label: Deploy Threat Hunting Saved Searches & ASIM Parsers
elements.toolTip: Deploys Log Analytics Saved Searches and ASIM normalization parser functions for advanced threat hunting.
